description: This source file defines a PHP class for a database driver implementing an ADO (ActiveX Data Objects) interface specifically for MS Windows environments using COM objects. It includes classes for handling database connections, executing queries, and managing recordsets via COM interfaces to interact with ADO data providers.

classes.name: ADODB_ado
classes.description: Represents an ADO database connection, with methods for connecting, executing queries, and managing transactions using COM objects.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ado
classes.description: Handles a database recordset retrieved via ADO COM objects, providing methods for fetching fields, moving through records, and closing the recordset.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the server/provider, including the provider description.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using COM objects with various provider options.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Creates a persistent connection to the database.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of table names from the connected database.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query using COM objects, returning a recordset object or false on failure.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current database transaction.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from the database.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code from the database.
